title: The Watcher
text: “You… did you bring it, nano?”
“There’s nothing inside — it’s just the same thing you made.”
“Well, that’s fine, nano. Gaelion will hand it over to Onee-chan when the time’s right, nano.”

With a series of clicks, the crystal holding Rival’s parent seemed to have been packed neatly away into some kind of compact case. It was probably only a matter of time before it activated. Jack was bound to make another pathetic showing this loop.
“By the way, Mesurion…-chan, what position and stance are you planning on taking this time?”
“For now, it’s just that Naofumi asked Gaelion to keep watch so Spear Hero doesn’t act up, nano. A watchdog role, more or less.”
“What’s the difference between you and Rafumi-chan? I don’t really get it… and shouldn’t we explain this to everyone?”
“It’s already established that Gaelion’s joined up, so skipping a fresh introduction makes things easier to move around, nano. Being compared to Rafumi is the part Gaelion hates, nano.”
“What? What exactly are you dissatisfied with about me?”
“You’re a wreck, nano. You’ve got a habit of doing whatever you please and ignoring things even when the whole situation spirals into chaos, nano.”
“Where exactly am I a wreck? Considering how much consideration I’ve shown throughout this loop, you — who got banished to another world by Spear Hero — have no right to say such a thing.”
“Sure, you’re useful as a fallback, but more than that, you’re the type reckless enough to pour oil on the fire just for the fun of it, nano.”
“Hmph… repeating the same thing over and over is dull. You emotionless bureaucrat.”
Rival and Rafumi were glaring daggers at each other. Just go ahead and destroy each other already, I say!
“Sounds like your roles overlap a bit?”

“Originally this was supposed to be Gaelion’s job, nano, but when Spear Hero blocked Gaelion’s entrance, the plan shifted to have Rafumi take over, nano. In this loop, though, Rafumi ended up doing the job first, nano.”
“I see… still, well…”
Rafumi had just been doing whatever she pleased, I say.

“What? What exactly is your problem? If you’re going to call me a wreck and trample all over my efforts on top of it, I’ve got a few tricks of my own. Spear Hero — perfect timing. If you hate the idea of Shield Hero being stolen away from you so much, why don’t I go ahead and do that thing I held back on the other day?”
“Why is the fallout suddenly landing on me!? This is completely unreasonable!”
“Fufufu… behold! My forbidden form!”
With a puff, Rafumi’s face stayed exactly as it was while everything below her neck shifted into Filo-tan’s body! Ugheeeh… not that form again!
“Stop it, I say!”
“You… you actually dug up the most ridiculous possible form just to torment Spear Hero, nano.”
“Whoa… Rafumi-chan’s face on top of Filo’s Filo Form.”
Father recoiled in horror.
“Come now, Spear Hero… if you want this to stop, there’s something you need to do, isn’t there?”
“Gah… Rival! Bow your head to Rafumi already! Otherwise she’s going to keep pulling stunts like this in that form!”
“Sounds like you’re trying to make Gaelion bow down, but that won’t work, nano. Gaelion happens to be a dragon quite skilled in magic, so this much is nothing, nano.”
With a snap of Rival’s fingers, Rafumi popped back into her original shape.
“What? You bastard… you used illusion magic to make my appearance look normal so I wouldn’t even notice? Then… what!?”
Just as Rafumi tried to pull something, she got zapped by what looked like static electricity, I say.
“Then let me show you that I can use the Hammer Seven Star Weapon right now.”

“If you’re going to go that far, Gaelion will just pull out something even bigger, nano. If you want to drag this into a drawn-out mudfight, Gaelion’s happy to oblige — but do you really want that, nano?”
“Hmph… this really is dull after all… fine. I’ll back down for now. But I am not a wreck. Don’t you dare forget that.”
What kind of standoff was that!? Just destroy each other already, I say!
“Well, this time it was mostly me pulling the strings. Don’t go spoiling every interesting thing that’s about to happen just to kill the mood.”
“Yes, yes, nano. Gaelion’s picked up on things well enough through the body’s memories, nano. Still…”
Rival turned and frowned at me. What, I say?
“Spear Hero, you should really stop hiding your messes — keep it up and you might actually end up dead for real, nano. You ought to come clean already, nano.”
“Huh? Is Motoyasu-kun causing some kind of trouble?”
“I haven’t caused any trouble like that, I say!”

In my memories, Ren and Itsuki were pointing at me, shouting liar! — but it wasn’t a lie, I say! Those two really ought to be playing the fool a bit more as inult and riska! It’s hardly an exaggeration to say that’s exactly what that magic was made for!
“Honestly… I’m amazed how much trouble you all cause without Gaelion around, nano.”
“Don’t make me repeat myself. Doing the same thing over and over is dull — put Spear Hero to better use.”
“Don’t toy with me, I say!”
“For now, you seem like the easiest one to talk to? Though you also seem oddly irritable.”

“Naofumi’s fine, nano. Well… since that noisy Spear Hero over there screeches so much whenever Gaelion gets close to Naofumi, it’d be best if Naofumi just spent time with whoever he actually likes, nano. Consider Gaelion already conquered on a separate route, nano.”

Rival waved a hand toward Father as if shooing him off, explaining it all with that gesture. Guh… remembering how Father had once offered himself up to Rival back when they went to Siltvelt sent a fresh stab of damage straight to my stomach, I say.
“Hmm… same stance as Rafumi-chan — you know, but you’re not telling. Very mature answer. Though at least you’re not doing some old commercial bit.”
“Rival! Cut that attitude out, I say! All you deserve is the pathetic sight of throwing a tantrum over wanting Father’s virginity, only to get shot down!”
Sure enough, she was going after Father with that mature little act, I say.
“I already told you, Gaelion isn’t after him, nano. Keep this up, and Gaelion really will go after Naofumi for real, nano — you sure you want that?”
“Could you please stop with that kind of talk? Motoyasu-kun’s persistence is already more than enough of a headache.”
“As long as results speak for themselves, Spear Hero won’t have a leg to stand on, nano. Just let him run off from home or whatever, nano.”
Damn you… Rival! Just how far do you intend to block my path, I say!
“Still, though… Motoyasu-kun has helped me out with plenty of things.”
Thankfully, Father didn’t seem all that enthusiastic about it. Still, I couldn’t afford to let my guard down, I say.

“Fufu… that’s fine too. Picture it — you, transformed into a beast consumed by explosive infatuation, assaulting Shield Hero while he cries out for help, and everyone around powerless to save him from you, forced to watch him get violated instead. That’s one possible outcome too, isn’t it?”
“Rafumi-chan… you really are something else…”
“Well, that’s after the second wave ends, though… we’ll just have to see how it plays out, so Gaelion will keep an eye on things for now, nano. Anyway, looking forward to more of this, nano.”
“You’re just ignoring me now… is that really fine on your end?”
“Depends entirely on Spear Hero, nano. Even so, Gaelion does cherish Naofumi, nano. Gaelion still holds onto the vow Naofumi made — loving every bit of Gaelion’s feelings — even now, nano.”
Guuuh… jealousy and hatred nearly warped my spear right there, but the vow I made to Filo-tan kept me holding on, I saaaaay!
“I feel like I just witnessed some kind of full-blown rivalry over Motoyasu-kun. I just hope the whole mess in Melromarc settles down soon…”

And that was how Rival ended up wedging herself into the conversation out of nowhere. On top of that, she seemed to think she now held some kind of leverage over me for keeping quiet about turning Ren and Itsuki into fairies. Sure, there was no real need to hide it, and it irked me to think she believed she’d caught me red-handed with some grand secret, so I figured it was about time I just came clean about it. Still, this was an enormous hassle right when I needed to start Fleon-chan’s training soon. Well, once this business was settled, I’d get right on it, I say.

And so, the very next day — the same day Kuro-chan also arrived in Zeltoble — I decided to put the plan I’d been cooking up into action, I say. I sent word ahead and summoned both Kuro-chan and Kou separately. The circus set up in Zeltoble had been arranged through a relative of the monster dealer, so it was fairly spacious, with each of us given our own tent. There were also apartments Father had rented nearby for lodging. I called Ren and Itsuki over to the building assigned to me there.
